title: Policy presets and sampling rules for prompts, responses, request logs, and metrics
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers need simple, auditable controls to set how long prompts, model responses, request logs, and aggregated metrics are retained across hosted, dedicated and private deployments. Current retention UX is too coarse (per-tenant or all-or-nothing), and engineering teams rely on ad-hoc scripts for sampled exports and evidence bundling.

Goals: Provide a product-first solution with: 1) a small set of policy presets (Default, Short-lived, PII-minimal, Audit-grade) that teams can apply per-route or per-model; 2) fine-grained sampling rules (percentage, deterministic hashing by user_id/session_id, stratified sampling by route or model) for large-volume traces and metrics; 3) region-aware residency pinning for retention and export; 4) automated evidence bundle generation for audits (signed manifest + hash-chained files) triggered by policy or manual request; 5) API and Console UI for authoring and previewing effective retention for routes and sample sets.

Scope: Console UI (policy presets editor, route selector, preview simulator), public API for retention profiles, sampling engine in the request pipeline, evidence bundler service, migration helpers (preview tool to estimate storage change), integration points with RBAC and KMS for export signing.

Out of scope: Per-prompt semantic classification (PII detection model), long-term archival formats beyond the initial signed bundle, legal counsel sign-off for policy language (we produce artifacts for compliance teams).

Deliverables: UI mockups + interactive preview, API spec, backend sampling implementation with deterministic hashing, evidence bundler lambda/service, migration script and a Canary rollout plan with telemetry and SLO guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Policy presets available in Console and via API and can be attached per-route or per-model
Sampling engine supports at least three modes: deterministic (hash key), percentage random, and route-stratified sampling
Preview simulator shows estimated retention volume and sample composition before applying a profile
Evidence bundle exports are produced as a signed zip with manifest, checksums, and an audit log entry
Regional residency setting enforces export and storage location decisions and surfaces conflicts in the UI
Migration preview provides estimate of storage delta and recommended sample rates to stay within budget
comments: 2026-03-10 Aisha Patel: Drafted ticket after tenant compliance calls; observed 3 customers asking for per-route retention presets.
2026-03-11 Luca Morgan: Added sampling modes and evidence bundle requirement based on ENG feedback; requested a technical spike to validate deterministic hashing cost impact.

2026-03-12 Priya Desai (Eng): Spike results attached — deterministic hashing adds negligible latency (p50 +2ms) but increases KV-index storage; we recommend an indexed keyspace and optional batching for high-throughput routes.
2026-03-13 Elena Rodriguez (Design): Uploaded initial wireframes: policy preset picker + route-level preview. Feedback: make conflict resolution explicit when tenancy-level retention is stricter.
2026-03-14 Product review: prioritized P1; schedule for Cycle 2026-W11. Next: 2-week implementation sprint with eng and design alignment meeting on 2026-03-16. Links to artifacts below.
notes: Trade-offs: Default presets reduce cognitive load but may not cover edge regulatory regimes; allow advanced JSON policy authoring for enterprise tenants.
Storage budgeting: recommend providing customers an estimated monthly cost delta in the preview simulator and an automated sample-rate suggestion to hit their target S3/GCS spend.
Security: evidence bundles must be signed with tenant KMS when available; fall back to platform signing with audit flagging when KMS not present.
